headline: SEBI Permits Net Settlement of Funds for Mutual Funds Starting April
summary: SEBI announced that mutual funds will be allowed to use net settlement of funds from April to ease funding needs, improve liquidity management, and boost operational efficiency.
why: SEBI regulates the securities markets in India, and its operational rule changes directly impact asset management companies and market liquidity.

impacts.name: Asset Management
impacts.why: Net settlement mechanisms reduce capital requirements and enhance liquidity management for mutual fund managers.
